newsitem.title: UK: UK shares mixed, cautious awaiting U.S. FOMC.
newsitem.headline: UK shares mixed, cautious awaiting U.S. FOMC.

text.p: UK stocks opened quietly on Tuesday, relieved that Wall Street had put in a firm performance overnight but cautious ahead of today's U.S. policy meeting and fears of an imminent interest rate rise.

The FTSE 100 index was up just 0.6 points at 4,645.8 to be barely changed by 0734 GMT. Gainers, losers and unchanged stocks were roughly evenly matched. The Mid-250 was similarly lacklustre, nudging up 0.8 points to 4,511.2.
"It's all about the FOMC today," said one dealer "But it's a bit of relief that the (Wall) Street ended where it did, and for that reason we'll see a steady start," he added.
